This year’s festival will feature internationally renowned jazz artists and local talents, blending traditional jazz with a vibrant Caribbean flair.

settle.description: Choose the outcome. This is the only place a payout is completed or rejected.

settle.failed_hint: Rejects the request. No money is taken and nothing is refunded.
settle.note_placeholder: Bank reference, who authorised it, anything worth recording…
settle.no_send_permission: You do not have permission to send payouts. You can still mark this request as failed, or ask an owner to grant you the payouts.send permission.
settle.wise_approve_hint: Confirms the recipient in Wise. No money moves. You send the transfer yourself afterwards.
settle.wise_sent_hint: You have already sent this transfer in Wise. Records it and debits the balance.
